newsitem.title: INDIA: Cricket - Rain delays start of India-Australia game.
newsitem.headline: Cricket - Rain delays start of India-Australia game.

text.p: Rain delayed the start of play in the Titan cup triangular one-day series preliminary league match between India and Australia at Cuttack's Barabati Stadium on Sunday.
Heavy overnight rains and continuous drizzle in the morning soaked the outfield and ruled out an early start. The wicket and the surrounding area remain under covers.
No decision on the start of play will be taken until it stops raining, cricket officials said.
Umpires Chandrakant Sathe and K.S. Giridharan will carry out hourly inspections of the ground, they said.

India won their first preliminary match against Australia last Monday and have lost both their matches against South Africa, who lead the standings table. South Africa have also beaten Australia in both their matches so far.
